## Tropics and Glacier Versions[]

The Orange Tropics and White Glacier versions start in the Tropical Field and Ice Field respectively, with the other of the two and the Forest Field unlocking at later Planet Levels. The Land, Water and Sky Fields are not present whatsoever, with most exclusive characters from it not appearing on the device.
